items.title: CayleyR: Solving the TopSpin puzzle via cycle intersection
items.summary: arXiv:2607.13219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present cayleyR, an R package for solving permutation puzzles by detecting cycle intersections in Cayley graphs.
